teams.why: Baseline is far slower than GPU (0.04x), so the main gains are in placement and the hardware. I'm splitting the team into three workers: one for the heavy matrix ops, one for attention, and one for hardware sizing. A fourth worker takes the small per-layer ops and link so they don't dilute the other

team.name: weights
team.brief: Move the weight MVMs and lm_head onto the PIM crossbars, and tune crossbar density (cell_bits, adc_per_ima, xbar_tile, xbar_scale) to fit the area budget.

team.name: attn
team.brief: Place attention and softmax on the PIM side, pick the KV storage (xbar vs vfu, transpose crossbars, kv_bits) and size the vector and nonlinear units.

team.name: elementwise
team.brief: Keep the small elementwise ops, embedding and sampling on the side that avoids CPU-PIM transfers, and pick the fastest link.

move.why: Put lm_head on the crossbars and use 4-bit cells with scale 1.0 to halve the arrays so the larger mapping should fit the area.
Moving attention to a 256-lane VFU with 1 TB/s, 64 GB KV memory and 8-bit KV, plus softmax on the VFU, removes CPU-side KV traffic and avoids new hardware lead time.
Fastest link (die) cuts CPU-PIM transfer cost for every remaining crossing, a pure win independent of placement.
Store KV in transpose crossbars so the K append is a single row write and q.K^T and p.V run in-array.
Fallback: move only the per-layer elementwise ops and final norm to star, leaving embed and sample alone.

log.why: Put lm_head on the crossbars and use 4-bit cells with scale 1.0 to halve the arrays so the larger mapping should fit the area.
Moving attention to a 256-lane VFU with 1 TB/s, 64 GB KV memory and 8-bit KV, plus softmax on the VFU, removes CPU-side KV traffic and avoids new hardware lead time.
Fastest link (die) cuts CPU-PIM transfer cost for every remaining crossing, a pure win independent of placement.
Lean tiles cut tile area 47%, freeing budget for more arrays so xbar_scale 1.5 can add parallelism.
Halving ADCs per IMA to 4 shrinks tile area with moderate read slowdown, and a scale of 1.25 may recover the speed.
Lean tiles alone at the same scale test whether the area saving is free in time.
Move softmax to a fixed-function nonlinear unit with 16 instances, which should be faster than running exp/normalize on the vector lanes.
Store KV in transpose crossbars so the K append is a single row write and q.K^T and p.V run in-array.
Put embed, sample and all small elementwise ops on the VFU next to the PIM crossbars so activations stop crossing the CPU-PIM link every layer (link is already the fastest, die).
violations: sample is sampling: it needs the full logits, an RNG and the token on the host; vfu_puma does not list 'sampling'
embed on vfu_puma: the token must cross in from the host every step (~0.00 us at 1000 GB/s), and the integrator charges no transfer for it
sample on vfu_puma: the token must cross back to the host every step (~0.05 us at 1000 GB/s), and the integrator charges no transfer for it
